title: Database Connection Pool Exhaustion from Unbounded Concurrent Event Processing in Worker
errorSnippet:
error: timeout exceeded when trying to connect, active connections: 20, max: 20
    at Pool.acquire (/node_modules/pg-pool/index.js:312:15)
    at processCallEvent (worker.ts:88:24)
environment: Node.js v22, PostgreSQL 16 (PgBouncer pool size 20), BullMQ / Kafka Consumer
rootCause:
### 5-Whys Root Cause Analysis
1. **Why did the worker fail?** Database pool threw timeout errors under traffic spikes.
2. **Why was the pool exhausted?** 200 Kafka events were processed simultaneously via `Promise.all(records.map(processEvent))`.
3. **Why were they all processed simultaneously?** The consumer loop did not enforce backpressure or concurrency limits.
4. **Why was there no backpressure?** Assumed Node.js asynchronous event loop would naturally queue tasks without overwhelming downstream connections.
5. **Core Root Cause (Mental Model Flaw):** Conflating asynchronous non-blocking I/O with infinite downstream capacity. Without a concurrency limiter (semaphore/p-limit), unbounded asynchronous concurrency exhausts socket and database pools.
